ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There are two parabolas in the figure. The parabola labeled f opens upward, with its vertex near (2,0) on the x-axis; the parabola labeled g opens downward, with its vertex near the origin (0,0). The two parabolas have the same shape, only opposite directions, and their vertices differ by 2 units in the horizontal direction. Reasoning: Writing the input of g as x-2, that is, g(x-2), means translating the graph of g 2 units to the right, so that its vertex moves from (0,0) to (2,0). After the translation it still opens downward, while f opens upward, so it equals the reflection of f about the x-axis, that is, -f(x). Therefore the relationship is g(x-2)=-f(x).

raw_record.question_text: The adjacent diagram illustrates the graphs of the two functions f and g. Using function notation, what equation describes the relationship between f and g?

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: the graph labeled f is an upward-opening parabola with vertex at (2,0), while the graph labeled g is a downward-opening parabola with the same shape and vertex at (0,0). The text asks for an equation in function notation relating f and g. Use the transformation rule that reflecting a graph across the x-axis multiplies its output by -1, and replacing x by x-2 inside g shifts the graph of g right by 2 units. Shifting g right by 2 moves its vertex from (0,0) to (2,0), aligning it with f, and because it opens downward while f opens upward, it is the reflection of f across the x-axis. Therefore the relationship is g(x-2) = -f(x).
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有两条抛物线。标为 f 的抛物线开口向上，顶点在 x 轴上的 (2,0) 附近；标为 g 的抛物线开口向下，顶点在原点 (0,0) 附近。两条抛物线形状相同，只是方向相反，并且顶点在水平方向相差 2 个单位。
推理：把 g 的输入写成 x-2，即 g(x-2)，表示将 g 的图像向右平移 2 个单位，使其顶点从 (0,0) 移到 (2,0)。平移后它仍开口向下，而 f 开口向上，所以它等于 f 关于 x 轴的反射，即 -f(x)。因此关系式为 g(x-2)=-f(x)。
method.answer_match_reason: The predicted answer exactly matches the standard answer: g(x-2) = -f(x).
